bounded_followup_discovery.scope: Selected local PDF excerpts searched via text, not exhaustive inspection of the full BBN archive. Only the 4068 passages identified above were newly used as visually checked progress-report evidence.
bounded_followup_discovery.4471_recovery_search: Local filename and public report-number/title/author searches did not locate a complete copy. This is a bounded search outcome, not proof that no full copy exists.
bounded_followup_discovery.3900_followup: Followed the implementation-report reference in BBN 3664. Original PDF text layer contains little useful text; new OCR used for discovery.
bounded_followup_discovery.negative_evidence_limit: Absent terms in short progress excerpts do not establish absence of features, work, or reports.

corrections_and_conclusions: Missing July 1976 SRI TCP source is recovered and identified before substantive use.
TCP and THP both contain Appendix A; previous possible citation mismatch withdrawn.
Requirement continuity through the 1980s is stronger than wire-format or immutable connection-policy continuity.
Reported EDN S/P/T tests strengthen implementation evidence while retaining TCC exception and missing-log limits.
AUTODIN II FTP names the protocol/application project, not the physical network carrying every test.

BBN 3119 supplies explicit architectural alternatives, including logical addresses invariant under changes of attachment; it also retains network state and trusts link checks, qualifying a simple end-to-end origin narrative.
Documented architectural reasoning and adaptation do not prove causation of the TCP/IP split or final Internet address choices.
